summary: TORP REGNSKAP AS (org. no. 974 475 642) is a private limited company (AS) based in Indre Østfold, in the Brønnøysund registers since 1995-06-06. It is active with no bankruptcy or liquidation registered. Its main activity is NACE 69.202 (Regnskapsføring og bokføring); it has 8 registered employees. In its 2025 accounts (company level) operating revenue was NOK 8.9 m and net income was NOK 1.3 m. CEO: Alf Ragnar Torp; board chair: Alf Ragnar Torp; auditor: CENTER REVISJON AS.
